At t=13m that signature broke: the 1m and 5m bars closed near their LOWS instead (clsInRng 0.11/0.25) with no bounce, 5m hurst jumped to 0.797 (trending, not mean-reverting) and reversion_prob_30 fell to the episode's lowest reading (0.689), alongside an HA-against fire -- a genuine character change from chop to trend-against, so I bailed. Next time I'd watch for that same combo (close-at-low + hurst regime jump + reversion_prob dropping through ~0.7) as the tell that a dip has become a real breakdown rather than treating each new local low as equally likely to rebound.
